target.statement: CE-GRPO achieves an average accuracy of 76.04 across nine geometry benchmarks, outperforming Qwen3-VL-8B by 8.09 points
target.dataset: Nine geometry benchmarks (MathVerse, VisOnlyQA-Syn/Real, MathVista-GPS, Geometry3K, PGPS9K, GeoQA, GeoLaux-mini, MM-Math)

compute.basis: Reproducing the headline requires SFT on 18,302 traces plus CE-GRPO RL with full-parameter updates on an 8B VLM, which the paper runs on 64x A100-80GB; this is far beyond an 8-core/16GB CPU laptop and would take days even on a single GPU.

blockers: Requires training an 8B-parameter vision-language model (Qwen3-VL-8B) with full-parameter RL
Paper reports 64x A100-80GB for CE-GRPO and 8x A100/MI300X for all baselines
No released code, data, or checkpoints despite the GitHub link
Evaluation uses Gemini-3.1-Pro/2.5-Pro as LLM judges, a closed API
Nine benchmarks and multiple baselines must be re-run to reproduce the average
title: Learning Where Outcomes Change:Credit-Addressable Reasoning for Multimodal Geometry
